title: Hola catalog index
description: The generated root catalog.json the Hola server consumes via HOLA_CATALOG_URL. Written by bin/build-catalog.sh; checked by bin/validate-catalog.mjs. Deliberately narrow: it constrains the fields the server reads (and the channel grammar it enforces), and allows unknown ones — the server ignores what it does not know.

channel.description: Release channel this version is listed on (try-hola/hola ADR 0005). Absent or null means `stable`. The server DROPS an entry whose channel is outside this grammar rather than defaulting it to stable, so a typo here would make the version invisible on every host — hence the pattern is enforced at publish time.
